rationale: Actual cancelled children and Root receipt share one bank admission/commit. A publication can own staged children as well as the result, so refusal restores the complete admitted session captured before dialogue withdrawal rather than copying live values or reverting selected metadata fields. Contract markers remain1; no fallback ledger, body cloning, token renaming, Cargo dependency change or build-artifact copying is introduced.

disposition: ProductSessionCheckpoint retains the existing admitted snapshot, execution admission and formatting context; it restores the complete executor at the existing transaction boundary. ProductStep remains the lifecycle owner. This introduces no second live resource ledger or cross-layer dependency.

PreparedPatternBinding is the single AWBC resource-to-register proof used by both Dialogue and AwaitMany. RuntimeAffineHandle projects its closed identity; shared line state projects only its own ledger family from the same traversal. The two replaced AWBC destination walkers are deleted.

PresentationBanks owns shared preflight and exclusive commit of contour exit, receipt escapes and discarded tokens. Plans contain token/header metadata, never cloned surface bodies. FiberFrame exposes the actual scope reference; callers do not reconstruct scope identity.

The new receipt test module owns actual D factory/VM Select/Root publication and save/rollback regression coverage. Existing line and lifecycle modules retain their responsibilities; no public production API is widened merely for file splitting. Exact changed-owner sizes and dependency metrics are retained alongside the scanner report.
